description: Wooden crate: plank walls with gaps on all six sides inside a frame of edge battens. Pivot at the centre of the base. Pieces: crate_planks (wood), crate_frame (wood_dark). Every piece is a closed box.

seed.desc: random seed of the plank tint

plank_pts.note: one point per plank: P, scale (box size), tint

frame_pts.note: 12 edge battens: vertical posts full height, horizontal battens between them

paint.note: Cd = the material's base colour (times the optional point attribute tint)

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
